name: unify-workloom-alignment
title: 统一 workloom alignment skill 与需求对齐门禁
description: 以 workloom-alignment 统一 Phase 1.1 的需求探索、UI/TDD 适用性与 design-tree pressure-test，并重构 alignment 凭据、PRD hash 失效机制、门禁、迁移检查及双 runtime 注册。
creator: northwang-lucky

grilling.summary: Final reconvergence after implementation research: full-PRD SHA-256 with CRLF/CR normalized to LF; language-neutral open-node marker; same-hash confirm is idempotent without timestamp refresh; stale_alignment is a distinct audited gate covering new and continuation executor dispatches; protocol version is checked at DSH/Pi startup with package semver build assertions; smoke uses isolated DSH headless and Pi sandbox only; workloom_task_align remains main-session-only. User accepted every recommendation.

dispatches.title: 梳理 alignment 重构影响面
